tasks.acceptance_prose:
CHROME4 of the OO visual-parity program. CHROME3 delivered the #backstage-overlay shell (rail + panes triggering existing dialogs). Now the panes get REAL content. The editor already speaks to wo-docserver: api() helper builds URLs, GET /api/documents/{id} returns metadata json {id,name,size,updated_at,format,...}, GET /api/documents lists stored documents (see core/crates/wo-docserver/src/editor_docs.rs document_list), and documents are served at /editors/document/<id> (editor.js is booted per document; DOC_ID constant).

PANES (content area of the existing backstage):
1. RECENT/OPEN pane (default pane on open): on backstage open, fetch GET /api/documents (once, cache per session). Render rows: document name + formatted updated_at date (toLocaleDateString via current locale — applyLocale aware) + size if present. Row click → location.assign to the editor URL for that id: derive from current pathname — if location.pathname matches /editors/document/([^/]+) replace the id segment; ELSE (standalone /word/ serve, no docserver) rows render disabled with title hint. Fetch failure/timeout (standalone file serve, stubbed fetch) → friendly empty-state row (i18n'd 'No stored documents / standalone mode'). Never crash the backstage.
2. INFO pane: fetch GET /api/documents/<DOC_ID> meta (degrade: show name from DOC_NAME); rows: Name, Format, Size (human KB/MB), Updated (locale date); below: live counters from the existing word/char count state (Words, Characters — same source as #sb-word-count).
3. PRINT pane: short description (i18n) + big primary button → existing print command path (reuse whatever the current print data-cmd/handler does — window.print or print dialog; do not implement new print logic).
4. SAVE AS pane: description + button → existing save/export flow (existing dialog data-cmd).
5. HELP pane: static keyboard-shortcut table (Ctrl+S save, Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo, Ctrl+B/I/U formatting, Ctrl+F find, Ctrl+H replace, Ctrl+wheel zoom — read actual bound keys from editor.js, do not invent) + About line (WorldOffice version string from any existing version constant; if none, 'WorldOffice Document Editor').

CONSTRAINTS: i18n EVERY new string en+de (FileScreen.* namespaced, follow existing key style). All fetches guarded (try/catch, AbortSignal.timeout(4000)). No new dialogs — reuse. DIALOG_IDS routing already covers the overlay. Keep backstage-probe.mjs green (rail + Esc/Tab unchanged).

DELIVERABLES: index.html pane content, editor.js pane logic (recent fetch+render, info meta, navigation), i18n.js en+de, style.css (list rows, meta grid, shortcut table — light+dark), scripts/backstage-deep-probe.mjs (port 18055, playwright recipe as chrome-probe.mjs, stub fetch via addInitScript BEFORE load returning two fake documents for /api/documents and meta for the demo id): asserts (a) backstage open → recent pane visible with 2 rows (names rendered, dates formatted); (b) row click in /editors/document/ context (stub location.pathname via history.replaceState before click) navigates (location.assign called — spy it) with the right id; standalone context → row disabled; (c) info pane shows meta rows + word counter matches editor count after typing; (d) print pane button click dispatches the print data-cmd path (spy window.print or the handler); (e) fetch failure stub → empty-state row, no pageerror; (f) 0 pageerrors throughout. backstage-deep-gate.test.mjs static pins (i18n keys en+de present, api/documents referenced, no invented shortcuts — grep the shortcut keys asserted against editor.js bindings). Commit 'feat(CHROME4-BACKSTAGE-DEEP)'.

tasks.acceptance_prose:
CHROME5 of the OO visual-parity program (depends CHROME4: same files). Pure polish + one control (zoom slider).

1. ZOOM SLIDER (statusbar): OO shows a slider + percent in the bottom-right. The editor has zoom state from BUG5 (Ctrl+wheel zoom, zoom buttons, Ctrl+0 reset — grep editor.js for the zoom implementation, there is a single applyZoom/setZoom state + status). ADD a styled range input (#sb-zoom-slider) in the statusbar zoom cluster, wired BOTH ways: input event → setZoom(value); zoom changes from wheel/buttons → slider.value + label update. Range covers the same bounds the zoom implementation enforces (find them; typical 50-400). Existing zoom buttons + wheel + Ctrl+0 keep working and stay in sync (tests pin them — do not break). Show percent label (#sb-zoom-val) next to the slider (if not already shown by a label, reuse). Slider styled OO-like: accent-color / custom track-thumb CSS, light+dark themes, accessible (aria-label i18n Statusbar.ZoomSlider en+de, keyboard arrows work natively).
2. CONTEXTUAL TAB ACCENTS: OO highlights contextual tabs (Chart Design, Draw, Header&Footer) — when a hidden contextual tab becomes visible+active, its .ribbon-tab gets class .contextual (or data-contextual) → accent styling: colored underline/top border (OO blue-ish family, use existing accent var) + slightly tinted inactive state while visible. Wire: the existing code that reveals contextual tabs (grep hidden attribute removal / aria-selected changes for chart-design/draw/header-footer) adds/removes the class. The tab must look plain when a normal tab is active even if contextual is visible (OO: contextual tabs colored, active tab filled — keep active-pill styling, add the accent border to the contextual ones).
3. RIBBON MICROSTATES: all ribbon buttons (.rb-group button, .ribbon-tab, qa buttons): transition background-color/border-color 120ms ease; :hover per theme vars; :active pressed (darker + translate 0 1px); :focus-visible subtle ring (existing focus styles — unify, no double rings); consistent 28px icon button squares; disabled (aria-disabled/disabled) state grayed + no hover. Sweep the whole ribbon once for stragglers (menus, selects, split buttons, color swatches).
4. TAB STRIP TYPOGRAPHY: OO tabs ~12.5-13px, medium weight for active, normal inactive, ~2px letter spacing none, height 28-32px total; polish paddings (10-14px horizontal), the File tab visually distinct (OO File tab is tinted) — subtle.

DELIVERABLES: index.html (slider, labels), editor.js (two-way sync, contextual class wiring — no new zoom logic, reuse setters), style.css (slider, accents, microstates, typography, light+dark), i18n.js en+de, scripts/polish-probe.mjs (port 18056, recipe as chrome-probe.mjs): (a) slider exists, value == current zoom; set via evaluate input event → zoom applied (editor scaling var/transform or zoom state readable — assert via the statusbar label AND the internal zoom state exposed on window if any; if not readable, assert the existing zoom buttons' effect on the slider and vice versa: click zoom-in button → slider.value increased); (b) Ctrl+wheel over editor → slider syncs; Ctrl+0 resets slider to 100; (c) select a chart (insert chart via existing ribbon path or dispatch) → chart-design tab visible with contextual accent (computed border/underline color differs from Home tab) and switching back to Home keeps chart-design accent; (d) hover microstate: dispatch mouseover on a ribbon button → computed background changes (read before/after); (e) 0 pageerrors. polish-gate.test.mjs static pins (slider markup + aria, i18n keys, .contextual CSS rule, transition rule exists). Update pinned tests if the statusbar markup changed (grep sb-zoom in tests). Commit 'feat(CHROME5-POLISH-ACCENTS)'.
